input.quote: This Agreement including all Exhibits, and the Non Disclosure Agreement and the Statement of Work referenced in this Agreement and incorporated by reference herein, constitutes the final, complete and exclusive agreement between the parties with respect to the subject matter hereof, and supersedes any prior or contemporaneous agreement.
input.rationale: Searches for "solicit", "hire", "induce" and "employees" return no restrictive covenant on personnel anywhere in the Agreement. The only personnel-related provisions are Section 13 (Shared Resources), which obliges Commerce One to provide access to its operations, consulting and engineering personnel and to have them under NDA/invention agreements, and Section 14.5 (Independent Contractors) — none of which restricts Corio from soliciting, hiring or engaging Commerce One personnel. Section 14.10 confirms the integration of the Agreement with only the NDA and Statement of Work, so no non-solicit is imported by reference. This matches the preferred position (no non-solicit binding the Customer), so no redline is required.
